iid_verdict.iid_conclusion: Second-order i.i.d. -- the condition the peaks-over-threshold step actually consumes -- is not rejected for either filter: the smallest Ljung-Box p-value on the squared innovations is 0.512 under Gaussian innovations and 0.590 under Student-t, and the ARCH-LM p-values are 0.571 and 0.603. First-order dependence in the levels is marginally detectable before correction (minimum p 0.029) and is not significant once the four tested lags are accounted for. Normality of the innovations is rejected outright (Jarque-Bera p 2.98e-219, residual kurtosis 4.92), which is a statement about the Gaussian likelihood, not about the threshold model: the GPD layer estimates the tail from the exceedances and never assumes normality. The defensible claim is therefore martingale-difference behaviour with short-range dependence, not strict i.i.d.

headlines.frequency: 46 exceptions in 4531 out-of-sample days, a rate of 1.015% with an exact 95% interval of [0.744%, 1.352%], which contains the 1.0% target.
headlines.magnitude: Each miss cleared the forecast by 0.8066% on average ($806,591 on a $100,000,000 book) and by up to 3.9285% ($3,928,498), leaving $37,103,165 unreserved over 18.0 years of out-of-sample history.
headlines.reserve: Holding expected shortfall rather than value at risk means carrying $829,808 more at every mark, an uplift of 28.2% on the reserve. That extra capital is held on all 4531 days, whereas the $20,607,036 of loss it prevents going unfunded -- about $1,146,099 a year -- is realised only on the days the tail appears. It is not a complete fix: it does not absorb the whole VaR shortfall, because 20 of 46 exceptions (43.5%) still clear expected shortfall, leaving $16,496,129 uncovered.

economic.stock_versus_flow: Incremental capital is a level held at every mark; unreserved loss is a total realised only on breach days. They are reported side by side and never added.

optimisation.comparability_warning: Breach counts across two books are not a model comparison: they price different loss series. Calibration is read within a row, risk reduction across rows.

optimisation_control.reason: The names are chosen by letter, not by anything the optimiser could exploit, so a result that survives this cut is not an artefact of which survivors are in the sample.

weight_robustness.tautology: Historical VaR is the empirical quantile of the same window it is scored on, so its breach rate is pinned near the nominal one for every weight vector. The spread that matters is zero, and the figure labels this test full-sample.

nan_policy: A NaN or a missing value is written as null and listed in non_finite_paths, with its meaning in null_meanings, so the file is valid JSON for any tool and nothing silent is hidden. The report build refuses to render a null that is not accounted for here.
